Stockfish 19 — lite, single-threaded WebAssembly build
======================================================

Files in this directory:

  stockfish-19-lite-single.js
  stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm

Upstream build and release:
  https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js
  https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1

Engine source:
  https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish

License:
  GNU General Public License, version 3.
  See LICENSE.txt in this directory.

The engine is loaded as a classic Web Worker and controlled over the UCI
protocol. The WASM binary must be served with the application/wasm MIME type.
